title: 第15章 剑道天才青莲花开第16章 刘建出手一剑败北
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“罗诚，战吧！”
林山壮硕的身躯，爆发出磅礴的力量，他抬起头目光坚定看着罗诚，没有丝毫畏惧。
“不自量力，我成全你。”
罗诚闻言，脸色愠怒。
他现在修为是融血境二重巅峰，只差一步就可以突破融血境三重。
林山不过刚突破融血境一重，根本不可能是他的对手。
身上磅礴的灵力流动。
唰！
就见到他猛然抽出腰间的长剑，银色的剑芒闪烁，一剑携带着剑气，朝着林山刺出去。
“来得好。”
林山见到罗诚长剑袭来，不仅没有惧意，反而弥漫着强烈战意。
主动迎上去，躲避开罗诚长剑袭击。
《奔雷拳》施展出来。
不愧是修炼到渐入佳境的境界，拳头之上灵力汇聚，隐隐约约能够感受到雷电闪烁。
“这样也想要躲避我的《凌风剑法》，这可是我们罗家的黄级中品剑法。”
罗诚长剑猛然刺出来，出剑速度也变的越发的凌厉快速，不断地朝着林山袭击。
唰唰唰……
一道道剑芒不断迸发出来。
刚开始林山还能够凭借渐入佳境的《奔雷拳》应对。
两人交手十多招后，他已经渐渐落入下风。

“林山要败了。”
“罗家的《凌风剑法》也不简单。”
“罗诚毕竟是融血境二重巅峰。”
“无论他们怎么战斗，最终都是要败给刘建的。”
眼看着两人在擂台上不断交手，不少人纷纷议论起来，明显已经要分出胜负了。
“那个罗诚真不要脸，他明明打不过山哥，就是在利用融血境二重巅峰修为强行压制。”
“要是山哥也突破到融血境二重，罗诚根本不是他的对手。”
“真是可恶。”
“可惜我们林家《奔雷拳》只是黄级下品，要是有黄级上品拳法，山哥保证打的罗诚屁滚尿流。”
林家的几个少年，见到林山被罗诚逼得节节败退，满脸愤怒，纷纷捏紧拳头。
“胜败乃兵家常事，你们几个切记戒骄戒躁。”
林毅听到林度等几个少年的气话，对着几人语重心长的教导道。
他眼角的余光，却忍不住瞥向林晨。
content_en:
"Luo Cheng, let's fight!"
Lin Shan's strong body burst out with majestic power. He raised his head and looked at Luo Cheng firmly without any fear.
"Don't overestimate your ability, I will help you."
When Luo Cheng heard this, his face became angry.
His current cultivation level is at the peak of the second level of the Blood Fusion Realm, and he is only one step away from breaking through to the third level of the Blood Fusion Realm.
Lin Shan had just broken through to the first level of the Blood Fusion Realm, so there was no way he could be his opponent.
The majestic spiritual energy flowing through his body.
Uh-huh!
He suddenly drew out the long sword from his waist, the silver sword light flashed, and the sword thrust towards Lin Shan with sword energy.
"Well come."
When Lin Shan saw Luo Cheng's long sword coming, he not only showed no fear, but was filled with strong fighting spirit.
Take the initiative to greet him and avoid the attack from Cairo Cheng's sword.
"Thunder Fist" was unleashed.
As expected of someone who has gradually reached a better state of cultivation, the spiritual energy gathered on his fist, and he could vaguely feel the flash of thunder and lightning.
"You also want to avoid my "Ling Feng Sword Technique", which is the yellow-level middle-grade sword technique of our Luo family."
Luo Cheng's long sword suddenly thrust out, and the speed of the sword became sharper and faster, attacking Lin Shan continuously.
Swish, swish, swish...
One after another sword light burst out continuously.
At the beginning, Lin Shan was able to cope with it with his "Thunder Fist" which was getting better and better.
After the two exchanged more than ten moves, he gradually fell into a disadvantage.
"Lin Shan is going to lose."
"The Luo family's "Ling Feng Sword Technique" is not simple either."
"Luo Cheng is, after all, at the peak of the second level of the Blood Fusion Realm."
"No matter how they fight, they will eventually lose to Liu Jian."
Seeing the two people fighting in the ring, many people started talking, and it was obvious that the winner was about to be decided.
"That Luo Cheng is so shameless. He obviously can't beat Brother Shan, so he is using his second-level peak cultivation in the Blood Fusion Realm to forcefully suppress him."
"If Brother Shan also breaks through to the second level of the Blood Fusion Realm, Luo Cheng is no match for him."
"It's so abominable."
"It's a pity that our Lin family's "Thunder Fist" is only a low-grade yellow-level fist. If there is a high-grade yellow-level boxing technique, Brother Shan is guaranteed to beat Luo Cheng's shit."
Several teenagers from the Lin family, seeing Lin Shan being forced to retreat by Luo Cheng, were filled with anger and clenched their fists.
"Victory and defeat are common matters in military affairs. You guys must guard against arrogance and impetuosity."
Ji Yi heard the angry words of Lin Du and other young people, and gave them serious instructions.
Out of the corner of his eye, he couldn't help but glance at Lin Chen.
